definitions.gloss: empress consort; queen consort; royal wife
definitions.explanation: The wife of an emperor or king. In Japanese history, refers specifically to the consort of the emperor.

examples.japanese: {妃|きさき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{宮殿|きゅうでん}→宮殿：12285_kyuuden⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{散歩|さんぽ}していた→散歩する：26840_sanposuru⟧。
examples.english: The queen consort was strolling through the palace garden.

examples.japanese: ⟦{物語|ものがたり}→物語：03634_monogatari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、{若|わか}い{妃|きさき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{運命|うんめい}→運命：06879_unmei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{左右|さゆう}→左右：02826_sayuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{決断|けつだん}→決断：13250_ketsudan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下|くだ}した→下す：12329_kudasu⟧。
examples.english: In the story, the young queen made a decision that determined the fate of the country.

notes:
USAGE: {妃|きさき} is a classical and literary term. In modern Japanese, ⟦{皇后|こうごう}→皇后：16354_kougou⟧ is more commonly used for the empress consort.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {妃|きさき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧ (to take a consort)
- ⟦{王妃|おうひ}→王妃：13634_ouhi⟧ (queen consort — uses on'yomi ひ)
- {皇太子妃|こうたいしひ} (crown princess)

The kanji {妃|きさき} has two readings: きさき as a standalone word and ひ in compounds such as ⟦{王妃|おうひ}→王妃：13634_ouhi⟧ and {妃殿下|ひでんか}. The standalone reading きさき has a classical, dignified tone and appears frequently in historical texts and fairy tales.
